# Product description (120 words)

Startup Board Pro is a startup advisor that scores your evidence before it
gives you anything.

Every claim you make gets a score from 0 to 3: your opinion, something you
read, a customer describing what they actually did, or someone who paid. The
score decides what you can have. A Lean Canvas needs evidence behind it. A
pitch deck needs traction you can verify. It will not tell you that you have
product-market fit while a signal is unmeasured, and it will not read fit at
all when you have no active users.

It asks one question at a time, never compliments your idea, and remembers
your venture between sessions — opening each one on the test you have not run.

Markdown only. Nothing to install but the files.
